rule: Per buff tag, a tolerance counter steps down on each repeat application inside a sliding window measured from the last application (step reductions 1..n as percent of duration). When the next step is not stronger, or the ladder has no next step, the target gets an immune buff and the ladder restarts. Duration = template base + level duration x ability level, then caster and owner modifiers, then the current step's reduction, then a PvP-only character reduction, then any forced duration. Stack rule per buff (refresh drops a weaker new application; default branch replaces a shorter instance at MaxStack). Control flags (stun, root, sleep, silence, cripled, knockdown, fastened) gate NPC movement and AI and interrupt skills; a Character whose CC is on a victim at death gets assist credit. Real-time buffs keep ticking offline; paused buffs do not.

data_fields.name: tolerance_step_reduction
data_fields.unit: percent of duration, per step, steps ordered by id

look_test: Phone 375 wide, one enemy in a three-attacker fight. (A) flat 1.5 s stun each hit; (B) ladder 0, 50, 75 percent reduction then an immune beat, three-pip indicator under the enemy bar, short resists flash on the immune step; (C) B without pips. Judge whether B reads as tougher rather than broken, whether the pip row is legible at 375 wide, and whether the immune flash lands in time.
